nodes.text:
2 cases of #hmpvvirus - in Chennai & Salem.

They are stable, says #TamilNadu’s health department while telling public not to panic since it’s not a new virus & first identified in 2001.

#HMPV infections are self- limiting & resolve with symptomatic care, hydration & rest.
